registry_title: Historical Twitter/X and adjacent social-text datasets

source_document.filename: Historical Twitter_X Datasets_ Verified Download Links.pdf
source_document.note: Dataset facts and license/access descriptions are transcribed from the user-provided PDF. The PDF says entries were verified against live pages on its compilation date; this project has not independently re-verified each provider page.

usage_policy.download_policy: Do not download datasets automatically as part of normal setup or CI. Review the provider page, license, terms, schema, and size first.
usage_policy.repository_policy: Never commit raw datasets, hydrated tweet text, credentials, or generated model artifacts. Keep data in ignored local storage or approved external storage.
usage_policy.point_in_time_policy: For predictive modeling, retain source timestamps and timezone, use only posts available before each forecast cutoff, and evaluate chronologically with walk-forward splits.
usage_policy.platform_policy: StockTwits is a separate platform and must never be labelled X/Twitter data. Tweet-ID-only collections do not contain recoverable full text by themselves.
usage_policy.license_policy: Treat the license/access field as a summary from the source PDF, not legal advice. Confirm the current provider terms and redistribution rules before use.

datasets.name: StockTwits 2008–2022 (NYU, Journal of Quantitative Description)
datasets.license_access: Free; direct public S3 CSV download reported
datasets.relevance: Potential finance sentiment research dataset, but not X/Twitter and very large.
limitations: Different social platform; keep separate from X/Twitter cohorts.
Reported size exceeds 71 GB; do not download by default.
Review source documentation and license terms before use.

datasets.name: Tweets about the Top Companies from 2015 to 2020
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: CC0 Public Domain; free, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Potential equities sentiment candidate covering AMZN, AAPL, GOOG, MSFT and TSLA.
limitations: Historical period ends in 2020; do not assume current-market generalization.
Inspect timestamp precision, duplicates, retweets, symbol mapping and missing values before modeling.
Kaggle page may request a free account.

datasets.name: Bitcoin tweets — 16M tweets
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: CC0 Public Domain; free, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Potential Bitcoin sentiment dataset for a crypto-specific experiment.
limitations: Large download (about 4.2 GB).
Historical period ends in 2019; align price data exactly to available timestamps.
Inspect schema and duplicate/bot behavior before use.

datasets.name: Bitcoin Twitter Sentiment Dataset (2013–2023)
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: CC0 Public Domain; free, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Potential broad historical Bitcoin sentiment corpus.
limitations: Very large reported size (44.9 GB).
Source PDF reports spam, bots and duplicates removed; validate this claim and remaining quality.
Historical period ends in 2023.

datasets.name: Bitcoin Tweets
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: CC0 Public Domain; free, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Potential Bitcoin corpus beginning in 2021; source PDF reports ongoing updates.
limitations: Approximate count and size are from a Hugging Face mirror card as reported in the PDF.
Check dataset snapshot/version and collection cutoff before each experiment.
Kaggle access may request an account.

datasets.name: Bitcoin Tweets Dataset (2025–2026)
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: CC0 Public Domain; free, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Potential newer Bitcoin corpus useful for post-2023 data coverage.
limitations: Record count is not stated in the PDF.
Source PDF reports bi-monthly updates; pin a snapshot/version for reproducibility.
Verify exact timestamp coverage and license on the provider page.

datasets.name: Crypto & Stock Tweets (Hugging Face)
datasets.approximate_size_display: Parquet; size not stated in PDF
datasets.license_access: CC-BY-4.0; free, no login, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Promising manageable mixed-domain candidate; source PDF reports 2.62M stock and 5.75M crypto tweets from 10 public sources.
limitations: Merged multi-source corpus: inspect source provenance, overlap and deduplication before analysis.
Attribute the dataset and satisfy CC-BY-4.0 conditions if confirmed.
Date ranges are mixed across contributing sources.

datasets.name: US Election 2020 Tweets
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: CC0 Public Domain; free, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Not a first-choice financial sentiment dataset; could support general-domain robustness tests only.
limitations: Election-specific topic can induce strong domain bias.
Geolocation is only available where provided.
Not recommended for asset-price forecasting without a justified hypothesis.

datasets.name: Sentiment140
datasets.format: Kaggle dataset; files to be inspected after download
datasets.license_access: Other; consult dataset description for license, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Potential sentiment model baseline/training corpus, not direct market-specific evidence.
limitations: License is explicitly unclear in the PDF; do not use or redistribute until checked.
Very old general-domain language may differ from finance/crypto language.
Labels are sentiment annotations, not asset returns.

datasets.name: Twitter historical dataset: first 3 years of Twitter (Zenodo)
datasets.license_access: Non-commercial research only; free download, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Not suitable for immediate text-based sentiment without authorized hydration.
limitations: Contains IDs only; full text is not included.
Hydration requires compliant access and many IDs may no longer resolve.
Non-commercial research restriction reported; likely incompatible with commercial use unless clarified.

datasets.name: COVID-19 Twitter dataset (40M+ tweets, Zenodo)
datasets.format: Tweet IDs with timestamps; hydration required
datasets.license_access: Public Domain; free download, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Non-financial corpus; not a first-choice dataset for market sentiment.
limitations: IDs only; original text requires compliant hydration and some posts are unavailable.
COVID-specific topical bias.
Do not treat ID counts as retrievable full-text counts.

datasets.name: BillionCOV (IEEE DataPort)
datasets.format: Tweet IDs and metadata; hydration required
datasets.license_access: Open-access listing; download via IEEE DataPort, according to source PDF
datasets.relevance: Not a first-choice financial sentiment corpus.
limitations: ID corpus; hydration required for text and availability is not guaranteed.
Very large corpus and COVID-specific topic bias.
Confirm account/access and usage terms before attempting retrieval.
